summary: Listed as an 80-ft steel tower with a 7x7 cab, erected 1953 at Myakka; put up for auction in 2013; no later record of its fate.

events.note: Listing says an 80-foot steel tower with a 7x7 cab was erected in 1953.
Tower placed on the auction block, with bids to be opened August 27, 2013. The listing does not record the outcome.

evidence.supports: 1953 erection of an 80-foot steel tower with a 7x7 cab
evidence.quote: 1953: An 80-foot steel tower with a 7x7 cab was erected.

evidence.supports: 2013 auction notice with bids to be opened August 27, 2013
evidence.quote: The tower was placed on the auction block, bids to be opened August 27, 2013.

evidence.supports: Listing is the site's only entry; it has no present-day account of the site

notes_for_editor: Single source: a volunteer-run lookout listing with two dated lines and no citations. Its location field reads 'Myakka State Park'; it does not name a managing agency, so the brief's agency value is not supported as one. Two web searches and a check of the Florida chapter's 2015 field report and the Myakka State Forest sources found no other record of this tower, and nothing on whether it was sold, moved or removed after the 2013 auction. Do not confuse it with the 75-foot observation tower on the park's canopy walkway, which a 2010 Tree Foundation post describes; that is not the same structure as far as the listing shows, and it is not cited here.
